content.text: Yes, the app is available on both platforms and can be downloaded from the App Store or Google Play. It gives you access to every game category on the platform, including draws, slots, live dealer tables, and Instant Win titles. Your login details are stored securely and the app runs reliably on mobile data.

sections.heading: What happens to my bonus balance if I do not meet the wagering requirement?

content.text: Bonus funds that have not been converted through the required playthrough are not eligible for withdrawal. If your account is closed or the bonus expires before the requirement is met, the remaining bonus balance is forfeited. Always check the expiry window for each promotion before you start playing through it.

sections.heading: Can I try slots and table games Keno for free before depositing?

content.text: Every title in the library has a demo option available directly from the game card. You do not need to log in or fund your account to access it - just open the game and select the demo mode. It is the most straightforward way to get comfortable with a new format before putting real money on the line.

sections.heading: Are there any limits on how much I can win from free spins?

content.text: Yes, winnings from free spins are subject to a maximum cashout cap that varies depending on the promotion. The cap applies to the total amount you can withdraw from those winnings, not to what you can win during play. Any amount above the cap is removed from your balance when the bonus is settled.

sections.heading: What should I do if I cannot complete a Keno login because I have forgotten my password?

content.text: Use the password reset link on the login page and follow the steps sent to your registered email address. Make sure to check your spam folder if the reset email does not arrive within a few minutes. Once your password is updated, we recommend enabling two-factor authentication to add an extra layer of security going forward.

sections.heading: Does the platform offer any ongoing promotions for existing players?

content.text: Yes, active players have access to reload free spins three times a week and a cashback credit every Friday with no wagering conditions attached. The amount of reload spins you receive scales with your deposit, and the cashback is calculated on your net losses for the week. VIP members unlock additional rates and perks on top of the standard ongoing offers.
